mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_members (room_id, user_id, role, joined_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{role}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, user_id, role, joined_at, last_seen_at FROM room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.joined_at, m.last_seen_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS nickname, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatar_url, COALESCE(ur.rating, 1000) AS rating, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM room_members m LEFT JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_ratings ur ON m.user_id = ur.user_id WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY CASE m.role WHEN 'host' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.joined_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.joined_at, m.last_seen_at FROM room_members m INNER JOIN rooms r ON r.id = m.room_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN ('OPEN', 'FULL') ORDER BY m.joined_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.joined_at, m.last_seen_at FROM room_members m INNER JOIN rooms r ON r.id = m.room_id WHERE r.status IN ('OPEN', 'FULL') AND m.last_seen_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY m.last_seen_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
